scope: L1: preserve Windows-1254 legacy text when reading and editing

libraries.verified: 2026-11-07 L1: Encoding.RegisterProvider(CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance) enables legacy code pages; Encoding.GetEncoding with exception fallbacks preserves strict encode/decode. Context7 lacked the exact Utf8.ToUtf16 signature; Microsoft Learn confirms replaceInvalidSequences:false yields InvalidData for malformed UTF-8 and isFinalBlock:false permits NeedMoreData for a truncated final sequence (queries: "System.Text.Unicode.Utf8.ToUtf16 ReadOnlySpan<byte>, Span<char>, out int bytesRead, out int charsWritten, replaceInvalidSequences:false, isFinalBlock:false in .NET 10; exact OperationStatus.Done and NeedMoreData for valid partial UTF-8 sequence."; "System.Text.Encoding.GetEncoding(1254, EncoderFallback.ExceptionFallback, DecoderFallback.ExceptionFallback) with CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance registration .NET 10; Windows-1254 name and encoder exception fallback").
